Paired with the ZF-sourced 8-speed automatic transmission  a unit used across many premium brands  this drivetrain is well-supported, with parts and qualified technicians available throughout the metro Detroit area.At 132,946 miles, prospective buyers should budget for normal maintenance items: fluid flushes, spark plugs if not recently done, and an inspection of the brake system. Owners of Grand Cherokee L models at this mileage consistently report that the vehicles feel solid when properly maintained, with minimal major mechanical surprises.Why Buy From Turbo Motors? Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe. Rear collision mitigation - It has your back.  Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to monitor the area behind you.  If it senses an impending crash, it activates certain features to help prevent a collision or reduce the severity of it. Put your worries behind you with rear collision mitigation.Technology and Telematics Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. It's stop/go feature automatically brings the vehicle to a stop if traffic stops and  resumes distance pacing cruise when traffic starts to move again. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Brake assist - Stop right there.  Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now!  With brake assist, you will.  It uses the speed of the brake pedals travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. description: If you've been hunting for a capable, retro-styled off-road icon that still turns heads nearly two decades after its debut, this 2007 Toyota FJ Cruiser Sport Utility for sale at Diamond Auto Exchange in Colton, California is exactly what you've been looking for. With its unmistakable boxy silhouette, legendary Toyota reliability, and a 4.0-liter V6 under the hood, this FJ Cruiser represents one of the most distinctive SUV purchases you can make in the Inland Empire market today. About This 2007 Toyota FJ Cruiser This 2007 FJ Cruiser comes in with 121,287 miles on the odometer  a number that tells a story of real-world use, but one that should inspire confidence rather than concern. Toyota's 4.0-liter V6 engine is widely known in the automotive community for routinely surpassing 200,000 miles with proper maintenance, which means this FJ Cruiser has plenty of life left to offer. Whether you're looking for a weekend trail runner, a reliable daily driver with serious character, or a collector-worthy SUV that continues to appreciate in the used market, this vehicle checks all the boxes. Stock number DA4791 is ready for its next adventure  and next owner. 2007 Toyota FJ Cruiser Performance and Engine4.0-Liter V6 Power The heart of this FJ Cruiser is Toyota's 1GR-FE 4.0-liter V6 engine, paired with a smooth-shifting automatic transmission. This engine produces around 239 horsepower and 278 lb-ft of torque, giving the FJ Cruiser genuine muscle for both on-road cruising and off-road climbing. The automatic transmission makes it especially approachable for daily commuters who want the FJ's capability without the learning curve of a manual gearbox.This particular FJ Cruiser is equipped with 2WD, making it a great fit for buyers in the Colton and greater San Bernardino County area who want the FJ's rugged styling and V6 punch for everyday driving without the added complexity of a four-wheel-drive system. The 2WD configuration also tends to be lighter on maintenance costs over time. For buyers who commute across the Inland Empire or occasionally explore paved mountain routes, this setup delivers more than enough capability. Toyota FJ Cruiser Features and InteriorBuilt for Adventure, Designed to Last The FJ Cruiser's interior was engineered from day one to take a beating and bounce back. Toyota used easy-to-clean surfaces throughout the cabin, with rubber-sealed floors and durable seating materials that stand up to years of active use. The iconic wraparound dashboard, oversized gauges, and retro-inspired trim bring a sense of fun to every drive that most modern crossovers simply can't replicate.The FJ Cruiser's unique rear suicide doors provide access to the rear seating area, and while rear visibility is famously limited due to the thick C-pillar and small rear window, most FJ owners consider this a small trade-off for the vehicle's one-of-a-kind design. Standard features on 2007 FJ Cruisers include air conditioning, a multi-function steering wheel, power windows and locks, and a capable audio system  everything you need for a comfortable daily driver with a serious personality. Toyota FJ Cruiser Reliability and OwnershipOne of Toyota's Most Trusted Platforms The FJ Cruiser is built on the same platform as the legendary Toyota 4Runner and Tacoma, which means it inherits one of the most battle-tested engineering foundations in the automotive industry.
